state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`).

**The identity hash walks the whole value.** `value_hash` keeps one frame per open level on a heap stack, so `unique`, `diff` and `intersect` over values that differ only deep down hash them apart. The unit test `values_that_differ_only_deep_down_hash_apart` counts the comparisons a set makes. The ladder `benches/scaling/arrays/unique-deep.nvs` is flat. It was also flat on the release binary built before the fix, and nobody has explained why; the Rust test is the proof.

**The queue's claim, roster and purge are index seeks, and every roster text has a SQL Server case.** The MySQL socket leg of `db-matrix` fails with OS error 95 from Windows. Not checked under WSL.

**3 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red: `a-websocket-write-buffer-has-no-ceiling`, `a-task-is-charged-a-whole-stack`, `a-request-analyses-an-unchanged-document-again`. `proofs --gate` is red too; not checked why.
